title: Extract the duplicated ARB-loading helper out of 4 test/l10n regression tests
rule: Fowler lens — duplicated code; no numbered TQ rule, but violates this repo's own test/helpers/ convention
why: Each file hand-rolls its own private _loadArb (or inlines the equivalent) instead of using the test/helpers/ pattern already established by test_database.dart, firestore_fake.dart, etc. The copies have already drifted: 2 of the 4 (hebrew_shabbos_strings_il9_test.dart, icu_plural_il3_test.dart) gained a `../lib/l10n/...` CWD-fallback candidate list, while b1_vocab_keys_present_test.dart and no_hardcoded_percent_in_chart_subtitle_test.dart still resolve only a single hardcoded path. If the test-invocation CWD convention ever changes (different `flutter test` working directory in CI, a monorepo restructure, running a single file from an IDE rooted elsewhere), half these tests fail with an unhelpful 'file must exist' error while the other half quietly cope — proof the duplication isn't being kept in sync today, let alone as more l10n regression tests get added (a 5th copy already exists in test/l10n/account_picker_subtitle_copy_test.dart, outside this batch).
recommendation: Extract one `Map<String, dynamic> loadArb(String locale)` helper (using the two-candidate CWD-fallback) into a new test/helpers/arb_loader.dart, and have every test/l10n/*_test.dart import it instead of defining/inlining its own copy.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/arb_loader.dart exists and is the single definition of ARB-loading logic used by test/l10n/*_test.dart
grep -rn "_loadArb(String locale)\|final file = File('lib/l10n/app_" learning_tracker/test/l10n/*.dart outside test/helpers/ returns zero matches (usable as a Rule-0 grep checker)
